test.create(/parent)
test.create(/parent::/child)
test.create(/filler::trigger_pos)
filler.create(/parent::/child::/gc)
test.create(/mover::trigger_pos)
mover.move(/parent::/child, dest)
test.destroy(/filler::trigger_pos)
test.destroy(/mover::dest::/gc)
test.destroy(/mover::dest)
test.destroy(/mover::trigger_pos)
